display.purpose: The single page title: the homepage greeting, content-page titles.

headline.purpose: Category rooms, recipe title on mobile, major sections.

meta.purpose: Minutes and lei under prints; tabular figures.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for every state change.

motion.name: develop
motion.value: 1.7s ease; from blur(12px) brightness(1.4) contrast(.72) saturate(.15) scale(1.025)

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one decisive action on a surface, e.g. Clear filters in the empty state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #17181B; color: #F1F1EF; font: 600 0.9375rem/1.4 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #17181B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Keyword filter in the side menu; selected fills with ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #B7B9BD; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #17181B; font: 480 0.9375rem/1.4 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .22s, color .22s, border-color .22s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #17181B; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #17181B; border-color: #17181B; color: #FAFAF9; font-weight: 560; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #17181B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sort Buttons with Pencil Mark
components.description: Active field in ink with a direction arrow and a hand-drawn China Marker underline.
components.css: .ds-sort { display: flex; } .ds-sort-btn { position: relative; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; background: none; color: #50545B; font: 520 0.9375rem/1.4 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sort-btn:hover { color: #17181B; } .ds-sort-btn[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #17181B; font-weight: 620; } .ds-sort-btn svg { display: none; position: absolute; left: 7px; right: 7px; bottom: 7px; width: calc(100% - 14px); height: 7px; fill: none; stroke: #C4352B; stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-sort-btn[aria-pressed="true"] svg { display: block; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: An underlined field like a caption rule; no box.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.25"/><path d="m15.2 15.2 5 5"/></svg><input placeholder="Search recipes…"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; width: 320px; border-bottom: 1px solid #B7B9BD; transition: border-color .25s; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-bottom-color: #17181B; } .ds-search svg { fill: none; stroke: #50545B; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; flex: none; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; color: #17181B; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #62666D; }

components.name: Print (recipe card)
components.description: Square photo, 2px corners, wall label below: title, minutes, lei.
components.css: .ds-print { display: block; width: 180px; color: #17181B; text-decoration: none; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-print-photo { aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 2px; background: #E2E3E3 linear-gradient(135deg, #d9c9a5, #b5763f); } .ds-print h3 { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 520; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-print:hover h3 { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #B7B9BD; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-print p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #50545B; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-print p span { color: #62666D; }

components.name: Segmented Preference
components.description: Two-cell radiogroup for language, theme and text size.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; width: 210px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #B7B9BD; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-seg button { min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: none; color: #50545B; font: 500 0.9375rem/1.4 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button[aria-checked="true"] { background: #17181B; color: #FAFAF9; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Every page is a table of photographic prints under even light. The food photography carries all of the colour; the interface recedes into what a gallery would add to a wall: quiet labels, hairline rules, a neutral wall colour, and a single grease-pencil mark that shows what the reader has chosen.
keyCharacteristics: Square, sharp-cornered prints (2px) with captions set below the photo, like museum wall labels.
One variable family (Archivo, wdth 62–125, wght 100–900); width + weight = hierarchy.
Neutral paper / graphite / silver palette; one china-marker red reserved for "chosen" marks.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; the only shadow is the side-menu sheet.
44px minimum targets, 15px minimum UI text, 13px absolute minimum for metadata.
Motion that feels photographic: prints "develop" on load, lists re-sort with a glide.

rules.name: The Photograph Owns the Colour Rule
rules.body: The UI is grey. No tinted surfaces, no brand greens or yellows, no category colours. If a screen needs colour, it needs a photograph.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: China Marker is the only hand on the table and the only accent: it marks what the reader chose or did (active sort/tab, filter badge, ticked boxes, hover underlines), numbers things (steps, frame numbers), and washes the personal notes at 7%. Solid fills stay badge- or checkbox-sized; it is never body text, never a large field, never used for data.

rules.name: The Width Is Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Don't add a second typeface. Reach for width and weight before size; titles get wider and lighter as they get bigger.

rules.name: The Plain Case Rule
rules.body: No all-caps tracked labels. Labels are sentence case at Small or Meta size in Pencil.

rules.name: The 44 Rule
rules.body: Every interactive target is at least 44 × 44px.

rules.name: The No-Overflow Rule
rules.body: Nothing scrolls horizontally at 360px, in either language, at either text size.

rules.name: The Flat Wall Rule
rules.body: No card shadows, no hover lifts, no glass, no gradients over photographs.

rules.name: The Sharp Print Rule
rules.body: Never round a photograph more than 2px, and never put text, pills or gradients on it.

dos: Do let photographs be the largest and only colourful thing on every screen.
Do put captions (title, minutes, lei) below the photo, in the Meta style, with units in Soft Pencil.
Do use the semantic tokens (bg-wall, text-ink, text-ink-2, border-line, border-line-strong, text-mark) so both themes work without dark: overrides.
Do keep every target ≥44px and UI text ≥15px (0.9375rem); 13px (0.8125rem) is the floor for badges and short labels only.
Do use tabular figures for every number (minutes, lei, servings, quantities, counts).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable the develop animation, view transitions and scaling.
Do test at 360px, 390px, 768px and 1440px, in RO and EN, light and dark, normal and large text.
donts: Don't use emoji as icons (no ⏱ 💰 🥐). Use typography or a 1.6-stroke line icon.
Don't put text, pills, badges or gradients on top of photographs.
Don't use card shadows, hover lifts, glassmorphism, gradient text, or rounded "bubbly" cards (>3px) for content.
Don't introduce brand colours (greens, yellows, terracotta) or cream backgrounds; the wall is a cool grey.
Don't use China Marker outside the uses listed under The One Mark Rule, and never as a large fill.
Don't add a second typeface or all-caps tracked labels.
Don't hide the side menu's features elsewhere; filters, categories, links and preferences all stay in the menu.
